grade.message: A freight train derailed ahead of my Amtrak train (AMD07A) on Tuesday, about a third of the way to Los Angeles. We sat for two and a half hours, then they said a bus was another hour away and would only get me to my hotel late in the afternoon. I am 23 weeks pregnant, so I gave up and took an Uber, 350 dollars. I want that 350 back too. Amtrak emailed that a voucher will come in 5 to 7 days, and on the phone they said a refund answer takes 4 to 6 weeks. I want my money back, not a voucher. elena.rossi@example.com, card 6207.
